25 Access prohibitions: exemption from liability

(1) Neither an authorised person, nor the person under whose direction or control the
authorised person acts, is to be liable in damages for anything done, or omitted to be
done, by the authorised person in the exercise or purported exercise of a power under
section 23.

(2) Subsection (1) does not apply to an act or omission shown to have been in bad faith.

(3) Subsection (1) does not apply so as to prevent an award of damages made in respect
of an act or omission on the ground that the act or omission was unlawful by virtue
of section 6(1) of the Human Rights Act 1998.

(4) This section does not affect any other exemption from liability (whether at common
law or otherwise).

(5) In this section “authorised person” has the same meaning as in section 23.
